activities.lead: Write what you want to remember right now.
activities.placeholder: What happened today, judgments or details to keep…
activities.mention_hint: Type @ to mention an existing node or create a new one.
activities.mention_create_exists: That id already exists — pick it from the list instead.
activities.mention_empty: No matching nodes. Keep typing an id, then choose Create.
activities.lock_hint: Memory is consolidating — writing is temporarily locked.
activities.locked: Memory is consolidating. Try again shortly.
activities.api_down: Cannot reach Engram API (default localhost:8787). Run: cd server && bun run start
activities.attachment_relationship_place: How this image relates to the memory…
activities.attachment_drop_hint: Drag images here, or paste from clipboard
activities.attachment_empty_relationship: Please fill in the attachment relationship
consolidate.lead: Dream a report first; commit long-term memory only after human review.
consolidate.revise_context_placeholder_r: What was wrong, and how should the next extract change…
consolidate.revise_context_placeholder_a: What to change on this same draft (minimal edits)…
consolidate.retry_reason_placeholder: What was wrong, and how should the next extract change…
consolidate.involvements_hint: Change category before approve. Live scores update only on approve.
consolidate.clarify_distill_none: No node mains changed by clarify distill this run.
advice.none: Status unavailable. Confirm the server is running on :8787.
advice.lock: Dream/commit in progress — please wait. Activities remain allowed during pending review.
advice.pending_review: Pending dream: read the report, then Approve, Discard, or Retry with a correction (same short-term event scope).
advice.l1_clear_pending: Committed but short-term memory clear failed — Approve again to retry clear only.
advice.dream_incomplete: Last dream failed (short-term memory kept). You can retry Dream.
advice.never_dreamed: No short-term memory yet. Add a few notes under Activities first.
advice.l1_empty: Short-term is empty — you can still Dream to backfill closed weeks/months/years.
advice.ready: Short-term memory has content; Dream to produce a pending report.
dream.l1_empty: Nothing to Dream — no short-term content and no closed week/month/year to roll up.
dream.approve_empty: Approved: no long-term writes; this round's short-term memory cleared.
dream.approve_retry_clear: Committed; short-term memory clear incomplete — Approve once more.
dream.approve_ok: Wrote {count} path(s) and cleared this round's short-term memory.
dream.discard_ok: Pending discarded (short-term memory / long-term understanding unchanged).
dream.retry_submitted: Retry submitted — waiting for a new pending review…
dream.amend_submitted: Amend submitted — waiting for updated pending review…
dream.pending_blocks_run: A dream is pending review — Approve, Discard, or Retry with reason first.
seek.lead: Find by keyword or ask AI.
memory.lead: Browse the memory chain and nodes.
memory.chain_empty: No entries in this chain yet.
memory.search_lead: Search short-term memory, day chain, nodes, and future-sight by keyword.
memory.ask_lead: Ask in natural language; the agent reads the store (hot future-sight by default; enable later separately).
memory.ask_placeholder: e.g. What did we decide with Acme last week?
clarify.lead: Answer system follow-ups, or add a note that should refine understanding — not a new Activities entry.
clarify.lock_hint: Memory is consolidating — clarify writes are temporarily locked.
clarify.locked: Dream in progress; clarify write rejected.
clarify.prompts_empty: No open follow-ups. New ones appear after a dream.
clarify.aside_lead: Freestyle notes that refine standing understanding. Not written to the Activities log.
clarify.aside_placeholder: Something the dream should fold into nodes…
memory.ask_busy: Another ask is running — cancel it first.
